newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CELTIC BEAT HIBS TO SET UP CUP CLASH WITH RANGERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CELTIC BEAT HIBS TO SET UP CUP CLASH WITH RANGERS.

text.p: Glasgow Celtic set up a quarter-final clash with arch-rivals Rangers by beating Hibernian 2-0 in a Scottish Cup fourth round replay on Wednesday.
Phil O'Donnell scored a classy first-half goal for the home side, completing a move started deep in Celtic's own half by Italian Paolo Di Canio.
Di Canio then added an equally fine second after the interval to sink the Edinburgh side who had held Celtic 1-1 in the first match.
Motherwell beat Hamilton 2-0 in the night's other fourth round replay.
